title: Risilience: Climate Lands in EBITDA, Not the Discount Rate
summary:
Angela Brown, CEO of Risilience, on where a climate assumption actually lands inside aprivate equity underwriting model, and where it does not apply.
The post Risilience: Climate Lands in EBITDA, Not the Discount Rate appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Angela Brown, CEO of Risilience, explains how climate assumptions should be integrated into private equity underwriting models. According to the analysis, climate factors ultimately land within EBITDA rather than being applied to the discount rate, shifting how investors assess climate risks.

title: The next shadow-banking problem comes from insurance companies, where nobody was looking for a bank run
summary:
Delaware Life Insurance Company's 2025 balance sheet took on a startling new shape when the insurer corrected its annual filing: roughly $17 billion of investments were classified as related-party holdings, about 39% of invested assets, versus roughly $1.4 billion and 3% in the earlier version. Clear Spring Life and Annuity Company made a separate correction […]
The post The next shadow-banking problem comes from insurance companies, where nobody was looking for a bank run appeared first on CryptoSlate.
tags: Clear Spring Life and Annuity Company
content: Recent corrections in annual filings from insurers like Delaware Life Insurance Company and Clear Spring Life and Annuity Company have revealed unexpected changes in balance sheets and significant investments in related-party holdings. This disclosure highlights growing concerns regarding shadow-banking vulnerabilities within the insurance industry, drawing attention to potential risks similar to a bank run that previously went unnoticed.

title: Israeli minister warns of strikes on Iran despite potential US deal
summary:
Israeli threats could derail US-Iran diplomatic efforts, reducing chances for reconstruction deals and escalating regional tensions.
The post Israeli minister warns of strikes on Iran despite potential US deal appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: An Israeli minister has issued warnings regarding potential military strikes on Iran, even as diplomatic efforts involving the United States continue. Observers note that these ongoing threats risk derailing potential reconstruction deals and heightening regional tensions, casting uncertainty over the future of diplomatic talks between the nations.

title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors’
summary: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.
content: Real Trump Coins has denied authorizing the GOLD digital token or any other cryptocurrency. The Trump-linked entity blamed bad actors for the launch as questions continued to circulate regarding its social media accounts, associated web domains, and a highly concentrated token supply.

title: Quantum-proofing XRPL: Why Ripple’s ‘timing’ could matter for XRP
summary: XRPL enters a key phase as Ripple pushes quantum resistance while institutional demand and regulatory catalysts build for XRP.
content: Ripple is advancing quantum resistance for the XRP Ledger as the network enters a crucial development phase. This technological push coincides with growing institutional demand and potential regulatory catalysts surrounding XRP, highlighting the importance of strategic timing for the digital asset's future security and market positioning.

title: Cuba Applies To Join BRICS Alliance Ahead of the 2026 Summit
summary: Island nation Cuba has officially applied to join the BRICS alliance, and the expression of interest comes weeks…
content: Cuba has officially applied to become a member of the BRICS alliance. This expression of interest by the island nation comes ahead of the upcoming 2026 summit, signaling a significant move toward deeper international economic and political alignment with the expanding bloc of emerging economies.

title: From Record Short Squeezes to Massive ETF Inflows: Everything Driving Bitcoin Right Now
summary: The short squeeze sparked the rebound, but ETF and on-chain data suggest broader demand is now helping.
content: Recent market activity shows Bitcoin rebounding significantly, driven initially by a powerful short squeeze. Beyond the initial short-term market mechanics, fresh data highlights substantial inflows into exchange-traded funds alongside strong on-chain metrics. Together, these indicators suggest that broader, more sustained demand is currently supporting the cryptocurrency's upward momentum.

title: 503,364% Gain: BTC From 2011 Moves After 15 Years
summary: Bitcoin’s oldest holders are showing signs of renewed activity, with another wallet moving 10 BTC that had remained untouched since 2011.
content: An early Bitcoin investor who acquired coins in 2011 has transferred 10 BTC after remaining dormant for nearly 15 years. This movement highlights the continued activity of long-term holders in the cryptocurrency market, showcasing a massive percentage gain since the original accumulation period.
